title: Kite
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <linearGradient id='kiteGrad' x1='0' y1='0' x2='1' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#ff5b6e'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#ff9f43'/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id='kiteGrad2' x1='0' y1='0' x2='1' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#ffd93d'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#ffee94'/>
    </linearGradient>
  </defs>
  <!-- bridle strings -->
  <line x1='50' y1='50' x2='50' y2='94' stroke='#7ee0ff' stroke-width='2' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- tail -->
  <path d='M50 94 Q42 78 34 68 Q26 58 32 46' fill='none' stroke='#7ee0ff' stroke-width='2' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- tail bows -->
  <polygon points='38,71 45,68 42,76' fill='#ff4fa3'/>
  <polygon points='30,60 37,57 34,65' fill='#4ff5d0'/>
  <polygon points='28,47 35,44 32,52' fill='#ffd93d'/>
  <!-- main kite diamond -->
  <polygon points='50,8 82,44 50,80 18,44' fill='url(#kiteGrad)' stroke='#ffd3d8' stroke-width='1.5' stroke-linejoin='round'/>
  <!-- cross bars of kite -->
  <line x1='50' y1='8' x2='50' y2='80' stroke='#ffee94' stroke-width='2'/>
  <line x1='18' y1='44' x2='82' y2='44' stroke='#ffee94' stroke-width='2'/>
  <!-- quadrants shading -->
  <polygon points='50,8 82,44 50,44' fill='#ff8a5c' opacity='0.35'/>
  <polygon points='18,44 50,44 50,80' fill='#ff8a5c' opacity='0.35'/>
  <!-- centre dot -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='44' r='5' fill='#ffee94' stroke='#ff5b6e' stroke-width='1.5'/>
</svg>
